apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar-hack
apps.versionDescription: 9.0a. The whole house in twelve tongues — every room, every view, and Skelli's own voice, chosen once in a first-boot welcome and kept in a language room of its own in About; her minds' thinking never reaches the transcript again. Carries the persona stack: nineteen feelings, grudges and care, exact minds, tone reading, and the end-to-end sweep.
